filename: Debt Payoff Tracker - Credit Cards & Loans

section_bars.label: DEBT PAYOFF TRACKER  -  CREDIT CARDS & LOANS

formulas.formula: Track every credit card and loan, watch the balances fall, and see your debt-free date.
1. My Accounts: list each credit card and loan with its balance today, APR, minimum payment, due day and (for cards) the credit limit.
2. Payment Log: every time you pay, add a row. Add interest, fees and new charges from your statements too.
3. Balances, progress bars and the Dashboard update by themselves from the log.
4. Due Dates & Interest: pick a month to see what's due, what's paid, and what interest is costing you.
5. Credit Utilization: see how much of each card's limit you use, and what to pay to get under 30%.
6. Payoff Plan: choose snowball or avalanche and an extra amount to see your debt-free date.
7. Monthly Summary: payments, interest and your total balance, month by month for any year.
Smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you motivated.
Highest interest rate first. Saves the most money.
When a debt is paid off, its minimum rolls into the next one, so you keep paying the same total each month and the payoff speeds up.
Card balances divided by card limits. Under 30% helps your credit score; under 10% is excellent.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid, paid off, or a healthy number.
Yellow: worth a look (a promo rate ending soon, a payment due, a minimum barely above interest).
Red: something to fix (a typo, an account name not on My Accounts, an overdue bill).
Estimates use monthly interest; your real statements can differ a little.
Thank you for your purchase! Every payment is a step toward freedom.

kpi_cards.label: DEBT-FREE BY
kpi_cards.value: =IF('Payoff Plan'!$BD$5=0,"Debt free!",IF('Payoff Plan'!$BD$6="never","Over 25 years",DATE(YEAR('Payoff Plan'!$BD$9),MONTH('Payoff Plan'!$BD$9)+'Payoff Plan'!$BD$6-1,1)))

kpi_cards.label: INTEREST & FEES PAID
kpi_cards.value: =ROUND(SUMIFS('Payment Log'!$E$6:$E$505,'Payment Log'!$D$6:$D$505,"Interest",'Payment Log'!$J$6:$J$505,">0")+SUMIFS('Payment Log'!$E$6:$E$505,'Payment Log'!$D$6:$D$505,"Fee",'Payment Log'!$J$6:$J$505,">0"),2)

formulas.formula: Everything at a glance. It updates as you log payments.
One row per card or loan. Starting balance = the balance on the day you start tracking. Type the APR as 22.99 or 22.99%.
Paid So Far and Charges Added (interest, fees, new purchases) come from the Payment Log.
The date your starting balances are from. Monthly Summary opens on this year.
What you can pay on top of all the minimums. Used by the Payoff Plan.
Snowball (smallest balance first) or Avalanche (highest rate first).
The first month of the Payoff Plan (usually next month). Blank = this month.
Add a row for every payment. From each statement, also add the interest charged, any fees and new purchases.

section_bars.label: INTEREST & PROMO RATES (ESTIMATES AT TODAY'S BALANCES)

formulas.formula: Pick a month to see each bill's due date, what you've paid, and what's still due.
Type any date in the month. Blank = this month.
How much of each card's limit you're using. Lower is better for your credit score: aim for under 30%, and under 10% is excellent.
Tip: paying before the statement date lowers the balance the card reports.
